name: Join community
copy: ⚠️ Quiet is in beta and shouldn't be used for activities requiring security.
note: Two states side by side: the post-invite-link 'Join community' (Create new account / Recover account) and the three-way choice (Join with invite link / Join with QR code / Recover account) — the same three routes as mobile. This is the join sub-flow, not the app entry.

name: Full screen modal
copy: Paste your invite code to join an existing community.
You can create a new community instead
note: Desktop paste screen; the library calls it an 'invite code'.

name: Register username
copy: You need a username to send and receive direct messages. Your username will last forever, so choose it well. To support future development, Zbay charges a small fee of 0.025 ZEC, which is approximately $1 USD.
Your username cannot have any spaces or special characters, must be lowercase letters and numbers only.
note: Library component for registering a username on desktop.

name: modal/small
copy: This community uses a server (api.tryquiet.org). By joining you agree to this Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. (Note: server connection is not via Tor!)
note: modal/small at 800 wide — one of a responsive pair.

name: modal/small
copy: This community uses a server (api.tryquiet.org). By joining you agree to this Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. (Note: server connection is not via Tor!)
note: modal/small at 1064 wide — the other of the pair.

name: Modal full-window
note: The only desktop APP ENTRY found: 'Modal full-window' with Let's get started… / Join a community / Create a new community / Link devices — same three routes as mobile's Get started. From the Device linking file (Dec 2024), a year older than the mobile prototype.

name: Modal full-window
copy: Messages are still end-to-end encrypted, joining will be faster, and Quiet will work much better on iPhones.
Please fill out your shipping information if you want to include it
note: 'Modal full-window' with Add members → Want a server? on desktop.

name: Join community
copy: Paste your invite link to join an existing community.
You can create a new community instead
note: Older (Dec 2024) desktop join: paste your invite link.
